description: Returns one provider’s profile from GLP Winner: the full price list by drug, dose and plan for a US state, the coupon, ratings and their recent movement, GLP Winner’s assessment, how signing up works, how fast customer support answers email, the pharmacies used in that state with licence status and additives, and links.getStarted, the provider’s sign-up URL.

currently_taking_glp1.description: Whether the person already takes a GLP-1. Starter packs are for new patients. When this is omitted, a starter plan can appear among the results.

drug.description: Molecule the price list is limited to: semaglutide or tirzepatide.

provider.description: Provider name ("Framework"), slug ("framework") or numeric GLP Winner id.

state.description: The person’s US state, as a two-letter code ("TX") or a full name ("Texas"). Which providers are available, and some prices, depend on the state.

name: get_glp1_provider
title: Get a GLP-1 provider’s details
